prompt: Before 2024, among her own record-breaking streaks, in which Olympic event has Katie Ledecky broken the world record the second most times?
answer: The **women’s 800-meter freestyle**—she had broken the world record there **five times before 2024**, second only to her six record improvements in the 1,500-meter freestyle. Her most recent pre-2024 800m mark was **8:04.79 at the 2016 Rio Olympics**.
